name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Cover Page)
description: Cover page for the Common Paper Mutual NDA, capturing the purpose, effective date, term and other deal-specific details.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Standard Terms)
description: Standard terms of the Common Paper Mutual NDA governing the exchange of confidential information between two parties.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Standard agreement for a provider to supply access to a cloud service (SaaS) to a customer.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Agreement for early-stage product access where a design partner gives feedback in exchange for early use of a product.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Service level terms covering uptime targets, support response times and remedies for a cloud service.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Agreement under which a provider performs professional services for a customer as described in statements of work.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Terms governing the processing of personal data by a provider on behalf of a customer under data protection laws.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Agreement granting a customer a license to use a provider's software.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Agreement setting out the obligations and terms of a business partnership between two parties.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: HIPAA business associate agreement covering the handling of protected health information (PHI).

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Agreement for a time-limited pilot or trial of a product for evaluation purposes.

name: AI Addendum
description: Addendum to a main agreement covering the use of AI services, inputs and outputs.
